_comment: Optional Claude Code convenience layer — deleting the whole .claude/ directory leaves a fully functional project. Enforcement lives in pre-commit and CI; this hook only surfaces failures earlier, in-session, and the deny rules mirror the AGENTS.md branch discipline (no pushes to main, no force pushes, no history rewrites, no --no-verify gate-skipping) for Claude Code sessions. CI is the authoritative gate regardless; these denies just stop a session skipping it. Tradeoff: the hook runs after every file edit, so it is limited to fast operations (format + quick test run). The allow list is a scoped allowlist for /orchestrate (headless workers + git worktree management); it does NOT switch the project into a full bypass mode.

hooks.command: uv run ruff format --quiet . && uv run pytest -q -x >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'post-edit checks failed — run: uv run pytest' >&2; exit 2; }
